start: A person gets the gym's 'Become a member' link app.mettleup.fit/m/<CODE>; online payment is off (JOIN_PAY off today); no free trial

steps.action: Look at the preview
user_sees: Title 'Become a member of <gym>'
Line 'Pick a plan and send your details to <gym>. Pay at the gym desk.'
must_not: Another gym's name
A price that is not the gym's

steps.action: Open the link
user_sees: 'Become a member'
'Join in 3 short steps. You pay at the gym desk.'
'Step 1 of 3' 'About you'
must_not: An install prompt (this page never opens an app)

steps.action: Type the full name and mobile number, tap 'Verify with WhatsApp', then 'Open WhatsApp' and send the message
user_sees: 'Waiting for your WhatsApp message…' then the number confirmed
must_not: The next step opened without the number proof

steps.action: Step 2 'Your plan': pick a plan and a start date
user_sees: 'Pick a plan' with the gym's plans and prices
'Start date'
must_not: A plan of another gym
A price changed by the page

steps.action: Step 3 'Agree and send': tick the 18-or-older box and the health box, tap 'Send to the gym'
user_sees: The request kept, with the gym, plan, start day and total the gym server worked out (exact success words not read)
must_not: A request sent without the two ticks
Two requests from one tap

start: The gym has its free trial switched on (3 days)

steps.action: Look at the preview and the page
user_sees: 'You can try <gym> free for 3 days, or pick a plan and send your details. Pay at the gym desk.'
'Join in 3 short steps, or try the gym free for 3 days.'
must_not: '1 days' wording
A trial offered when the gym has it off

steps.action: Pick the free trial and send
user_sees: The trial's days and last day, as the gym server worked them out; no online payment offered for it
must_not: A payment asked for the trial

start: The number typed is already a member of this gym

steps.action: Send the form
user_sees: 'This number is already a member of this gym. You can renew your plan instead.'
'Renew at the gym desk, or in the MettleUp app: Gym → "My gym" → "Renew my plan".'
Button 'Use another number'
must_not: A second member or enquiry made for the number

start: The gym is not taking sign-ups online, or the link's code is no gym

steps.action: Open the link of a closed gym
user_sees: Preview '<gym> is not taking sign-ups online right now.'
'Please join at the gym desk.'
must_not: The form open for a closed gym

steps.action: Open a link with a wrong code
user_sees: 'This gym link does not work.'
'Ask the gym for a new link.'
must_not: Another gym's plans

start: The same number already used this gym's free trial

steps.action: Pick the free trial again and send
user_sees: A refusal that the trial was already used (TRIAL_USED; the page's words not read)
must_not: A second free trial for the same number

start: The person has sent the form

steps.action: Think about who sees the details
user_sees: Only that gym gets the name, number and plan; MettleUp's page server keeps only a salted one-way code of the network address; the number is proved by WhatsApp and kept in coded form by that check
must_not: Another gym getting the request
The page deciding the price

start: A person has just sent the 'Become a member' form

steps.action: Open Today, then Enquiries
user_sees: 'Joined online' on Today
The request in Enquiries with the name, number, plan and start date
must_not: The request in another gym
A price that differs from the gym's plan

start: A person asked for the free trial

steps.action: Look at the alert and the enquiry
user_sees: 'Free trial online: …' with the dates
must_not: The trial shown as a paid member

start: 30 online requests already came in today

steps.action: Look at Enquiries after a 31st try
user_sees: No new request for that person (they were told 'too many')
must_not: A half-made enquiry

start: The owner changes a plan's price while a person has the page open

steps.action: The person sends within 5 minutes of the change
user_sees: The request saved at the gym's current price (the gym server reads the price; the page's shown price may be up to 5 minutes old)
must_not: The request saved at a price the page made up

start: An online request is in the gym's Enquiries

steps.action: Check who else sees it
user_sees: Only this gym's owner and desk see the number
must_not: The request visible to another gym or to MettleUp staff without the support window

start: A person sent the form and will come to the desk

steps.action: Open Enquiries at the desk
user_sees: The online request with plan, start date and total
must_not: The request missing on the desk login

start: The gym server could not be reached when the person sent

steps.action: Look at Enquiries
user_sees: No request (the person saw a try-again message)
must_not: A half-made request

start: The same person sends again while their first request is still open

steps.action: Look at Enquiries
user_sees: One enquiry, the new request linked to it
must_not: Two enquiries for one person
